text: Unforgettable trip with the French captain Marie who knows Barcelona very well and was able to advise us for other cultural and tourist outings! The guitarist was at the top, he could play songs of his choice or ours, a treat! And a dive of the boat in the open sea for all those who wanted it was particularly appreciated by my whole family, really we recommend 100 percent! Thank you again.
author: 974cecilen

text:
This sunset sail with an amazing live guitar musician was just the highlight of our whole trip !!! 
The sea was gentle and the breeze just enough to set the sails and navigate away from the city to get the perfect views of the skyline of Barcelona. 
Amazing experience : very peaceful. The live music added the perfect touch of chill, excellent musician. 
Our captain Mary has been very nice and provided us explanations of the main sightseeings and some recomendation for going out. 
We really recommend this trip in music : don't miss it !!!
author: marienT4304CF

title: Unforgettable outing in music, with swimming and good humor included
text: Unforgettable experience with Marie, an adorable French captain who knows Barcelona perfectly and was able to advise us for other visits! The excellent guitarist delighted us by playing songs at our request and others of his choice that perfectly matched the Mood of the sunset... icing on the cake, we were able to swim in the open sea by diving from the boat, really an outing that we recommend to all those who pass through Barcelona and want to experience something exceptional
author: 974cecilen

title: Incredible sailing experience in Barcelona!
text: We had a great time, with incredible views of the city. All enlivened with great live music and the company of Captain Marie, who is a total genius! I recommend!

title: A wonderful anniversary at Spanish time
text: We wanted for our wedding anniversary to take the sun , the sea, the sea, and we were delighted, Captain Marie from our arrival is very welcoming, smiling , bubbly, listening to our desires. It was great, we could ask the guitarist for the melodies, music we wanted. Purely awesome, especially at sunset with the guitar in the background, awesome. Captain Marie very discreet and always present, very pleasant, you can go with your eyes closed.
